It refuses to cheerlead: it shows the movement delta, and the very first run exposed what every existing view HID - the done-counter fell from 1566 to 1256 over three days while depts-moving stayed flat at 12, so a real decline was invisible behind a green number. HARSH CRITICISM (increment): this is observability, not product; it moves no milestone and only lets Eitan TRUST the loop rather than DO anything new with the hub, which is worth less than a shipped feature. The delta I proudly surfaced comes from a rolling counter I do not fully understand, so -195 might be re-scoping not regression, and I shipped the alarm before diagnosing the cause - exactly the noise that teaches an owner to ignore his own dashboard. PULSE.md also triples up on AWAY_LOG and the guardrails card, and the questions count is a brittle regex that drifts the moment the file format changes. HARSH CRITICISM (plan): the away plan keeps producing meta-machinery - a logger, then a digest, now a pulse - instead of the hub and M1/M3 product Eitan actually asked to be perfected, because meta-machinery is CLI-verifiable and safe while real product needs the browser the plan forbids me to touch unattended: the plan is optimizing for what is easy to verify over what is worth building. And the rot the pulse just made visible - a done-counter declining three days straight under a fully green 15/15 - proves the guardrails measure liveness, not correctness: the program can go backwards in plain sight and still report all-clear, and nobody is assigned to ask why.

M2 class overhaul: shipped class 1 of 5 (Element/Package) as src/excava_core.py + regression test; migrated src/activate.py onto it
why: 14 modules each hand-rolled access to elements_index.json, re-deciding 'usable'/'stub'/'link' separately - that duplication IS the fragmentation the END PLAN 5-class collapse targets. Element is the narrowest most-depended-on shape so it goes first. Built as a typed accessor OVER element_model (still sole builder+write path), not a rewrite, so all 14 consumers keep working and are migrated one at a time per P5. First run found a real data bug: element_model._slug truncates at 60 chars, so 4 long command names collide and 6 records are UNREACHABLE by id - surfaced via duplicates() rather than silently swallowed; the slug fix re-keys the hub so it is a separate verified increment.

what: Always-on GO AWAY MODE + phone push tiering; loop_contract enforcement (ack/carry-over/meta-cap); owner_requests durable backlog; CLAUDE.md split into general guidance + ANALYZE_SPEC.md
why: Eitan is rarely at the computer, so a loop that idles waiting for him wastes most of the day - mode is now permanent and switches cadence instead of ending. Push is TIERED not per-detail: an owner who learns to ignore notifications is worse than no notifications. Contract was enforced by nothing (zero code consumers) so loop_contract makes it checkable at standing_checks. Carry-over + meta-cap attack the diagnosed-5-times-never-fixed plumbing bias: 81 fires produced mostly meta work because meta is what fits in one fire window. Owner asks needed their own store since backlog.refresh() regenerates wholesale. CLAUDE.md is now portable to his other projects; the project spec moved to ANALYZE_SPEC.md with analyze.yml/discover.yml/external_review repointed.

what: M2 class 2 of 5: Tool class in src/excava_core.py - wraps an OSS repo/MCP as callable; plus fixed a false-alarm bug in standing_checks/ensure_upstream introduced last fire
why: Element says a tool EXISTS, Tool says HOW TO RUN IT - the §8 highest-leverage lever (repos-as-running-tools) and item 16 (OSS usable not links). Detection is deterministic/offline so an agent can ask 'can I run this' for free; the network registry lookup is opt-in via resolve_online and reuses verify_connectors.resolve rather than a second client. MEASURED the real gap: only 54 of 8397 tool-capable elements carry a real command, and only 71 of 1463 connectors have any install field at all - the dashboard's paste-ready MCP config is mostly a placeholder, which is display-over-reality. resolve_online closed 5 of 6 sampled link-only connectors into registry-verified npx commands, proving the path. Also fixed: ensure_upstream hardcoded origin/main and clobbered branch tracking every call, making standing_checks report a permanent false 'HEAD and origin/main disagree' - a permanently-red check trains the reader to ignore it.

what: Merged 384 commits of main into the branch; widened guardrail G-S from .jsonl to .md and repaired 58 conflict-marker-corrupted files (47 artifacts, 11 handoffs)
why: Eitan asked the loop to check what already ran before each fire, to avoid repeating work. Doing that check found TWO things: (1) the branch was 384 commits behind main because a SECOND away loop is running there (fires 83-88, dated 2026-08-01) that this session knows nothing about - zero file overlap so no duplicated work, but the divergence was real and is now merged; (2) 58 files on main carry literal git conflict markers, 47 of them in data/excava/artifacts which IS M2.6's deliverable - so this was corruption in the PRODUCT, not just in a log, and G-S could not see it because it only ever scanned .jsonl. Widened the scanner to .md, kept the same removal contract (both sides' content preserved, only bare marker lines dropped), repaired all 58, verified line-for-line that nothing but markers moved.

what: git_safe merge-main: scripted the four conflict classes a branch-vs-main merge produces, proven on a synthetic repro
why: A SECOND away loop ships to main continuously (now at fire 89), so a branch session must merge main every fire or drift hundreds of commits - it was 384 behind two fires ago, 15 behind this one. Two fires running hand-resolved the SAME four conflicts identically; that repetition is both wasted effort and where the mistake happens (fire 89's first attempt deduped episodes.jsonl by id and would have destroyed 152k lines, because distinct entries legitimately share ids). Encoded the rules as REGENERATED/APPEND_ONLY/ACCUMULATING classes; anything unrecognised is deliberately LEFT conflicted for a human rather than guessed at. Proven on a throwaway repo where three entries share one id with different content - all three survived.

what: M2 class 3 of 5: Room class in src/excava_core.py - typed wrapper over excava_chat's proven room machinery, with artifact-reality verification
why: excava_chat already runs real multi-turn debate on real engines with 52 rooms and 2,305 artifacts behind it - rewriting it would destroy working machinery to satisfy a diagram, so Room WRAPS it. What was missing is a TYPE: rooms were passed as bare dicts so every caller re-derived 'is it finished', 'where is the transcript', 'did it actually produce anything'. artifact_is_real() is the important part - it checks the file exists, is non-empty, and carries no conflict markers, because 47 artifacts were found marker-corrupted on 2026-08-01 while every count still reported them as produced. Caught a real bug in my own first version: the artifact field is a DICT {kind,ref,at,title,by}, and stringifying it whole made every path unresolvable and reported 0 real artifacts out of 46 - checked before believing it, fixed, and locked with a regression assertion.

what: M2 class 4 of 5: Agent class in src/excava_core.py - typed wrapper over the 46-agent roster, with a can-act check and a has-actually-worked census
why: The roster turned out HEALTHY - every agent has scoped tools and every scoped module exists on disk - so this class is not about finding rot. Its value is answering what nothing could answer before: has this agent actually DONE anything, or is it a name in a file? That is the same law-P4 test Element.is_usable / Tool.is_runnable / Room.artifact_is_real apply. Answer: 36 of 46 have spoken in a room, 10 never have (EXCAVA, Refine, Frame, Prune, Assay, Squint, Overhaul, Vet, Remix, Tether). Computing it REQUIRES the Room class, which is the cross-class integration the collapse exists for - nothing orphaned.

what: Fixed excava_chat._speaker: the checker was structurally excluded from short rooms and the improver from ALL rooms; also taught git_safe merge-main that artifacts/handoffs are room OUTPUT (take theirs)
why: Chasing the debt I named last fire (10 agents named but never spoken) found a real orchestra bug, not idle departments. Measured: of 83 rooms with a transcript, the 70 at max_turns=3 had a checker speak in only 3, while all 12 at max_turns=6 did. Cause: the lead-converge window was a flat t >= max_turns-2, so a 3-turn room produced [doer, lead, lead] - one proposal then immediate agreement, no challenge at all. That is the correlated-error failure END PLAN section 2 exists to prevent, running in 85% of rooms. Separately the rotation was built only from doers and checkers, so all three improvers (Refine, Remix, Overhaul) were unreachable by any code path. Fix: converge window is 1 turn on short rooms, 2 only when the room can afford it; improver joins the rotation. Verified by simulation across 3/4/6-turn rooms and locked with 11 assertions.

what: M2 class overhaul: 5th of 5 classes (Router) built in src/excava_core.py
why: Eitan's merge of PR #43 landed classes 1-4 (Element/Tool/Room/Agent) and explicitly left Router as the missing 5th; Tool.invocation()'s own docstring already called its output 'the adapter spec the Router will read'. Router.route(text) composes excava_agents.pick_department + worker_for + REAL_TOOL/_task_tool_fit + excava_engines.pick_engine into one typed decision (department, agent, tool, tool_fits, blocked_reason, engine) so a caller no longer has to import 3 modules and stitch the trace by hand. Not a rewrite — same law as the other 4 classes: policy stays in excava_agents/excava_engines, Router only composes their real outputs. Added CLI 'python -m src.excava_core route "<text>"' + 7 regression assertions in excava_core_test.py (composition matches the standalone functions exactly, security always gets a grounded/reasoning engine, no-match never guesses a department, routable() requires a real worker or an honest blocked reason). Completes the M2 §2/§6 class-collapse milestone (5/5 classes now real).

what: Migrated build_hub_api onto Element/Package (2nd of 14 consumers) and fixed a real two-store package orphan; verified M2 complete (5/5 classes, Router landed by the other loop)
